def make_feats(view, snapshot_day):
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name="household_key")
    g = tx.groupby("household_key")
    def wsum(days):
        sub = tx[tx.day > snapshot_day - days]
        return sub.groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0)
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    for w,name in [(28,"s4"),(56,"s8"),(91,"s13"),(182,"s26"),(365,"s52"),(10**9,"sall")]:
        f[name] = wsum(w)
    for w,name in [(28,"b4"),(91,"b13"),(182,"b26")]:
        sub = tx[tx.day > snapshot_day - w]
        f[name] = sub.groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique().reindex(hh).fillna(0)
    last = g.day.max().reindex(hh)
    f["recency"] = snapshot_day - last  # NaN if never purchased -> but households must have >=84d history, so they purchased
    first = g.day.min().reindex(hh)
    f["tenure"] = snapshot_day - first
    # avg basket value last 13w
    sub = tx[tx.day > snapshot_day - 91]
    bv = sub.groupby(["household_key","basket_id"]).sales_value.sum()
    f["avg_basket_13w"] = bv.groupby("household_key").mean().reindex(hh)
    f["max_basket_13w"] = bv.groupby("household_key").max().reindex(hh)
    # trend
    prev = tx[(tx.day > snapshot_day-56) & (tx.day <= snapshot_day-28)].groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0)
    f["trend_4v4"] = f["s4"] / (prev + 5)
    # discounts
    f["coupon_disc_13w"] = sub.groupby("household_key").coupon_disc.sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0)
    f["retail_disc_13w"] = sub.groupby("household_key").retail_disc.sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0)
    # distinct stores/products
    f["nstores_13w"] = sub.groupby("household_key").store_id.nunique().reindex(hh).fillna(0)
    f["nprod_13w"] = sub.groupby("household_key").product_id.nunique().reindex(hh).fillna(0)
    # weekly spend rate
    f["rate_13w"] = f["s13"] / 13.0
    return f

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    s = int(snapshot_day)
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name='household_key')
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    for k in range(1, 15):
        lo, hi = s - 28*k, s - 28*(k-1)
        w = tx[(tx['day'] > lo) & (tx['day'] <= hi)]
        g = w.groupby('household_key')['sales_value']
        out[f'spend_w{k}'] = g.sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
        if k <= 6:
            out[f'trips_w{k}'] = w.groupby('household_key')['basket_id'].nunique().reindex(hh, fill_value=0)
    # ratios/trends
    eps = 1.0
    out['trend_w1_w2'] = out['spend_w1'] / (out['spend_w2'] + eps)
    out['trend_w12_w34'] = (out['spend_w1'] + out['spend_w2']) / (out['spend_w3'] + out['spend_w4'] + 2*eps)
    out['mean_w1_w6'] = out[[f'spend_w{k}' for k in range(1,7)]].mean(axis=1)
    out['std_w1_w6'] = out[[f'spend_w{k}' for k in range(1,7)]].std(axis=1)
    out['cv_w1_w6'] = out['std_w1_w6'] / (out['mean_w1_w6'] + eps)
    out['spend_yoy'] = out['spend_w13']  # same window last year already included
    # long-run rate
    g = tx.groupby('household_key')
    tot = g['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
    first = g['day'].min().reindex(hh)
    tenure = (s - first).clip(lower=1)
    out['spend_per_28d_all'] = tot / (tenure / 28.0)
    out['tenure_28d'] = tenure / 28.0
    return out

        out["gap_mean"] = gg["gap"].mean().reindex(hh)
        out["gap_std"] = gg["gap"].std().reindex(hh)
        out["gap_max"] = gg["gap"].max().reindex(hh)
        # weekly

        ws = t.groupby(["household_key","wk"])["sales_value"].sum().reset_index()
        wg = ws.groupby("household_key")["sales_value"]
        out["wk_spend_mean"] = wg.mean().reindex(hh)
        out["wk_spend_std"] = wg.std().reindex(hh)
        out["wk_spend_med"] = wg.median().reindex(hh)

    out["spend_per_trip_364"] = out["wk_spend_mean"] * 7 / out["trips_364"]  # hmm not exactly

import numpy as np, pandas as pd, agent_api

saved = agent_api.load_saved("rfm_traj_v1.parquet")

def build(view, S):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name="household_key")
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    tx364 = tx[tx["day"] > S - 364]
    first_day = tx.groupby("household_key")["day"].min()

        out["trips_364"] = gg.size().reindex(hh).astype(float)
        out["basket_mean_364"] = gg["val"].mean().reindex(hh)
        out["basket_std_364"] = gg["val"].std().reindex(hh)
        out["gap_mean"] = gg["gap"].mean().reindex(hh)
        out["gap_std"] = gg["gap"].std().reindex(hh)
        out["gap_max"] = gg["gap"].max().reindex(hh)
        out["spend_364"] = tx364.groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum().reindex(hh)
        t = tx364.assign(wk=tx364["day"] // 7)
        ws = t.groupby(["household_key","wk"])["sales_value"].sum().reset_index()
        wg = ws.groupby("household_key")["sales_value"]
        out["wk_spend_mean"] = wg.mean().reindex(hh)
        out["wk_spend_std"] = wg.std().reindex(hh)
        out["wk_spend_med"] = wg.median().reindex(hh)
        out["active_weeks_364"] = ws.groupby("household_key").size().reindex(hh).astype(float)
        age = (S - tx364["day"]).astype(float)
        hk = tx364["household_key"]
        for hl in (14, 28, 56, 112):
            wgt = np.power(0.5, age / hl)
            out[f"ew_spend_hl{hl}"] = (tx364["sales_value"] * wgt).groupby(hk).sum().reindex(hh)
    tw = (out["tenure_days"] / 7.0).clip(lower=1.0)
    if "active_weeks_364" in out:
        out["active_week_ratio"] = out["active_weeks_364"] / np.minimum(52.0, tw)
    out["spend_per_trip_364"] = out["spend_364"] / out["trips_364"]
    out["gap_cv"] = out["gap_std"] / out["gap_mean"]
    out = out.reset_index()
    out["snapshot_day"] = S
    return out

saved = agent_api.load_saved("rfm_traj_v1.parquet")
print("saved", saved.shape)
print(list(saved.columns))

def build(view, S):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name="household_key")
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    tx364 = tx[tx["day"] > S - 364]
    first_day = tx.groupby("household_key")["day"].min()
    out["tenure_days"] = (S - first_day).reindex(hh).astype(float)
    if len(tx364) > 0:
        b = (tx364.groupby(["household_key", "basket_id"])
                  .agg(day=("day", "min"), val=("sales_value", "sum"))
                  .reset_index()
                  .sort_values(["household_key", "day"]))
        b["gap"] = b.groupby("household_key")["day"].diff()
        gg = b.groupby("household_key")
        out["trips_364"] = gg.size().reindex(hh).astype(float)
        out["basket_mean_364"] = gg["val"].mean().reindex(hh)
        out["basket_std_364"] = gg["val"].std().reindex(hh)
        out["gap_mean"] = gg["gap"].mean().reindex(hh)
        out["gap_std"] = gg["gap"].std().reindex(hh)
        out["gap_max"] = gg["gap"].max().reindex(hh)
        out["spend_364"] = tx364.groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum().reindex(hh)
        ws = (tx364.assign(wk=tx364["day"] // 7)
                    .groupby(["household_key", "wk"])["sales_value"].sum().reset_index())
        wg = ws.groupby("household_key")["sales_value"]
        out["wk_spend_mean"] = wg.mean().reindex(hh)
        out["wk_spend_std"] = wg.std().reindex(hh)
        out["wk_spend_med"] = wg.median().reindex(hh)
        out["active_weeks_364"] = ws.groupby("household_key").size().reindex(hh).astype(float)
        age = (S - tx364["day"]).astype(float)
        hk = tx364["household_key"]
        for hl in (14, 28, 56, 112):
            wgt = np.power(0.5, age / hl)
            out["ew_spend_hl%d" % hl] = (tx364["sales_value"] * wgt).groupby(hk).sum().reindex(hh)
    tw = (out["tenure_days"] / 7.0).clip(lower=1.0)
    out["active_week_ratio"] = out["active_weeks_364"] / np.minimum(52.0, tw)
    out["spend_per_trip_364"] = out["spend_364"] / out["trips_364"]
    out["gap_cv"] = out["gap_std"] / out["gap_mean"]
    return out

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

def feats(view, snapshot_day):
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    hh = view.households
    day = snapshot_day
    tx = tx[tx.day <= day]
    age = (day - tx["day"]).astype(float)
    g = tx.groupby("household_key")
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    # EWMA spend and trips
    for H in (14, 28, 56, 112):
        w = 0.5 ** (age / H)
        out[f"ew_spend_h{H}"] = tx.assign(_w=tx.sales_value*w).groupby("household_key")["_w"].sum()
        # trips: weight per basket
        bt = tx.drop_duplicates("basket_id")[["household_key","day"]]
        bw = 0.5 ** ((day - bt["day"]) / H)
        out[f"ew_trips_h{H}"] = bt.assign(_w=bw).groupby("household_key")["_w"].sum()
    # fine windows
    for W in (7, 14):
        m = tx["day"] > day - W
        out[f"spend_{W}d"] = tx[m].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum()
        out[f"trips_{W}d"] = tx[m].drop_duplicates("basket_id").groupby("household_key").size()
    # 28-day blocks over past 364 days
    blk = ((day - tx["day"]) // 28).clip(upper=12)  # 0..12
    tb = tx.assign(blk=blk).groupby(["household_key","blk"])["sales_value"].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    tb = tb.reindex(columns=range(13), fill_value=0.0).reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
    out["blk_mean"] = tb.mean(axis=1)
    out["blk_median"] = tb.median(axis=1)
    out["blk_std"] = tb.std(axis=1)
    out["blk_min"] = tb.min(axis=1)
    out["blk_max"] = tb.max(axis=1)
    out["blk_cv"] = out["blk_std"] / (out["blk_mean"] + 1e-9)
    out["blk_active_frac"] = (tb > 0).mean(axis=1)
    out["blk_last_ratio"] = tb[0] / (tb.mean(axis=1) + 1e-9)
    out["blk_year_ago"] = tb[12]
    # slope: regression of block spend on block index
    x = np.arange(13); xc = x - x.mean(); denom = (xc**2).sum()
    slope = (tb.values * xc).sum(axis=1) / denom
    out["blk_slope"] = slope
    # longest zero run in blocks
    z = (tb.values == 0)
    def longest_zero(row):
        best=cur=0
        for v in row:
            if v: cur=0
            else:
                cur+=1; best=max(best,cur)
        return best
    out["blk_zero_run"] = [longest_zero(r) for r in z]
    # gaps
    last = g["day"].max()
    out["days_since_last"] = day - last
    # distinct stores 84d
    m84 = tx["day"] > day - 84
    out["n_stores_84d"] = tx[m84].groupby("household_key")["store_id"].nunique()
    # active days 28d
    m28 = tx["day"] > day - 28
    out["active_days_28d"] = tx[m28].groupby("household_key")["day"].nunique()
    # momentum ratios
    out["mom_ew_28"] = out["ew_spend_h28"] / (out["blk_mean"]*1.0 + 1e-9)  # hmm blk_mean is per 28d block; ew_spend_h28 approximates recent level
    out["spend28_over_blkmean"] = tb[0] / (out["blk_mean"] + 1e-9)
    return out
```

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

base = agent_api.load_saved("rfm_cadence_v1.parquet")
demo = agent_api.load_saved("demo_v1.parquet")
print("base", base.shape, list(base.columns)[:8], "...")
print("demo", demo.shape, list(demo.columns)[:8], "...")
t = agent_api.train_targets()
print("target n:", len(t), "zero-frac: %.3f" % (t.future_spend_4w == 0).mean())
print(t.future_spend_4w.describe().round(2))

def feats(view, snapshot_day):
    day = int(snapshot_day)
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    tx = tx[tx["day"] <= day]
    h = view.households
    hh = pd.Index(h["household_key"]) if isinstance(h, pd.DataFrame) else pd.Index(h)
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    age = (day - tx["day"]).astype(float)

    bt = tx.drop_duplicates("basket_id")[["household_key", "day"]]
    for H in (14, 28, 56, 112):
        w = np.power(0.5, age.values / H)
        out["ew_spend_h%d" % H] = tx.assign(_w=tx["sales_value"].values * w).groupby("household_key")["_w"].sum()
        bw = np.power(0.5, (day - bt["day"]).values / H)
        out["ew_trips_h%d" % H] = bt.assign(_w=bw).groupby("household_key")["_w"].sum()

    for W in (7, 14):
        m = tx["day"] > day - W
        out["spend_%dd" % W] = tx[m].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum()
        out["trips_%dd" % W] = tx[m].drop_duplicates("basket_id").groupby("household_key").size()

    blk = ((day - tx["day"]) // 28).clip(upper=12)
    tb = tx.assign(blk=blk).groupby(["household_key", "blk"])["sales_value"].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    tb = tb.reindex(columns=range(13), fill_value=0.0).reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
    vals = tb.values.astype(float)
    out["spend_28d"] = vals[:, 0]
    out["blk_mean"] = vals.mean(axis=1)
    out["blk_median"] = np.median(vals, axis=1)
    out["blk_std"] = vals.std(axis=1)
    out["blk_min"] = vals.min(axis=1)
    out["blk_max"] = vals.max(axis=1)
    out["blk_cv"] = vals.std(axis=1) / (vals.mean(axis=1) + 1.0)
    out["blk_active_frac"] = (vals > 0).mean(axis=1)
    out["blk_active_frac6"] = (vals[:, :6] > 0).mean(axis=1)
    out["blk_last_over_mean"] = vals[:, 0] / (vals.mean(axis=1) + 1.0)
    out["blk_year_ago"] = vals[:, 12]
    xc = np.arange(13, dtype=float); xc -= xc.mean()
    out["blk_slope"] = (vals * xc).sum(axis=1) / (xc ** 2).sum()
    z = (vals == 0)
    def lz(row):
        best = cur = 0
        for v in row:
            cur = 0 if v else cur + 1
            if cur > best: best = cur
        return best
    out["blk_zero_run"] = [lz(r) for r in z]

    out["days_since_last"] = day - tx.groupby("household_key")["day"].max()
    m84 = tx["day"] > day - 84
    out["n_stores_84d"] = tx[m84].groupby("household_key")["store_id"].nunique()
    m28 = tx["day"] > day - 28
    out["active_days_28d"] = tx[m28].groupby("household_key")["day"].nunique()
    out["spend_per_active_day_28d"] = vals[:, 0] / (out["active_days_28d"].values + 1.0)

    wk = ((day + 8) // 7) % 52
    out["week_of_year"] = wk
    out["week_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * wk / 52.0)
    out["week_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * wk / 52.0)
    return out

tbl = agent_api.build_features(feats)
if "household_key" not in tbl.columns:
    tbl = tbl.reset_index()
print("built:", tbl.shape, "n_new_feats:", tbl.shape[1] - 2)

m = base.merge(demo, on=["household_key", "snapshot_day"], how="left")
m = m.merge(tbl, on=["household_key", "snapshot_day"], how="left")
print("merged:", m.shape)
print("dup rows:", m.duplicated(["household_key", "snapshot_day"]).sum())
print("nulls in ew_spend_h28:", m["ew_spend_h28"].isna().sum())
path = agent_api.save_table(m, "ewma_block_v1")
print("saved:", path)

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

def feats(view, snapshot_day):
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    hh = view.households
    day = snapshot_day
    tx = tx[tx.day <= day]
    age = (day - tx["day"]).astype(float)
    g = tx.groupby("household_key")
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    # EWMA spend and trips
    for H in (14, 28, 56, 112):
        w = 0.5 ** (age / H)
        out[f"ew_spend_h{H}"] = tx.assign(_w=tx.sales_value*w).groupby("household_key")["_w"].sum()
        # trips: weight per basket
        bt = tx.drop_duplicates("basket_id")[["household_key","day"]]
        bw = 0.5 ** ((day - bt["day"]) / H)
        out[f"ew_trips_h{H}"] = bt.assign(_w=bw).groupby("household_key")["_w"].sum()
    # fine windows
    for W in (7, 14):
        m = tx["day"] > day - W
        out[f"spend_{W}d"] = tx[m].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum()
        out[f"trips_{W}d"] = tx[m].drop_duplicates("basket_id").groupby("household_key").size()
    # 28-day blocks over past 364 days
    blk = ((day - tx["day"]) // 28).clip(upper=12)  # 0..12
    tb = tx.assign(blk=blk).groupby(["household_key","blk"])["sales_value"].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    tb = tb.reindex(columns=range(13), fill_value=0.0).reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
    out["blk_mean"] = tb.mean(axis=1)
    out["blk_median"] = tb.median(axis=1)
    out["blk_std"] = tb.std(axis=1)
    out["blk_min"] = tb.min(axis=1)
    out["blk_max"] = tb.max(axis=1)
    out["blk_cv"] = out["blk_std"] / (out["blk_mean"] + 1e-9)
    out["blk_active_frac"] = (tb > 0).mean(axis=1)
    out["blk_last_ratio"] = tb[0] / (tb.mean(axis=1) + 1e-9)
    out["blk_year_ago"] = tb[12]
    # slope: regression of block spend on block index
    x = np.arange(13); xc = x - x.mean(); denom = (xc**2).sum()
    slope = (tb.values * xc).sum(axis=1) / denom
    out["blk_slope"] = slope
    # longest zero run in blocks
    z = (tb.values == 0)
    def longest_zero(row):
        best=cur=0
        for v in row:
            if v: cur=0
            else:
                cur+=1; best=max(best,cur)
        return best
    out["blk_zero_run"] = [longest_zero(r) for r in z]
    # gaps
    last = g["day"].max()
    out["days_since_last"] = day - last
    # distinct stores 84d
    m84 = tx["day"] > day - 84
    out["n_stores_84d"] = tx[m84].groupby("household_key")["store_id"].nunique()
    # active days 28d
    m28 = tx["day"] > day - 28
    out["active_days_28d"] = tx[m28].groupby("household_key")["day"].nunique()
    # momentum ratios
    out["mom_ew_28"] = out["ew_spend_h28"] / (out["blk_mean"]*1.0 + 1e-9)  # hmm blk_mean is per 28d block; ew_spend_h28 approximates recent level
    out["spend28_over_blkmean"] = tb[0] / (out["blk_mean"] + 1e-9)
    return out
```

def feats(view, snapshot_day):
    day = int(snapshot_day)
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    tx = tx[tx["day"] <= day]
    h = view.households
    hh = pd.Index(h["household_key"]) if isinstance(h, pd.DataFrame) else pd.Index(h)
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    age = (day - tx["day"]).astype(float)

    bt = tx.drop_duplicates("basket_id")[["household_key", "day"]]
    for H in (14, 28, 56, 112):
        w = np.power(0.5, age.values / H)
        out["ew_spend_h%d" % H] = tx.assign(_w=tx["sales_value"].values * w).groupby("household_key")["_w"].sum()
        bw = np.power(0.5, (day - bt["day"]).values / H)
        out["ew_trips_h%d" % H] = bt.assign(_w=bw).groupby("household_key")["_w"].sum()

    for W in (7, 14):
        m = tx["day"] > day - W
        out["spend_%dd" % W] = tx[m].groupby("household_key")["sales_value"].sum()
        out["trips_%dd" % W] = tx[m].drop_duplicates("basket_id").groupby("household_key").size()

    blk = ((day - tx["day"]) // 28).clip(upper=12)
    tb = tx.assign(blk=blk).groupby(["household_key", "blk"])["sales_value"].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    tb = tb.reindex(columns=range(13), fill_value=0.0).reindex(hh, fill_value=0.0)
    vals = tb.values.astype(float)
    out["spend_28d"] = vals[:, 0]
    out["blk_mean"] = vals.mean(axis=1)
    out["blk_median"] = np.median(vals, axis=1)
    out["blk_std"] = vals.std(axis=1)
    out["blk_min"] = vals.min(axis=1)
    out["blk_max"] = vals.max(axis=1)
    out["blk_cv"] = vals.std(axis=1) / (vals.mean(axis=1) + 1.0)
    out["blk_active_frac"] = (vals > 0).mean(axis=1)
    out["blk_active_frac6"] = (vals[:, :6] > 0).mean(axis=1)
    out["blk_last_over_mean"] = vals[:, 0] / (vals.mean(axis=1) + 1.0)
    out["blk_year_ago"] = vals[:, 12]
    xc = np.arange(13, dtype=float); xc -= xc.mean()
    out["blk_slope"] = (vals * xc).sum(axis=1) / (xc ** 2).sum()
    z = (vals == 0)
    def lz(row):
        best = cur = 0
        for v in row:
            cur = 0 if v else cur + 1
            if cur > best: best = cur
        return best
    out["blk_zero_run"] = [lz(r) for r in z]

    out["days_since_last"] = day - tx.groupby("household_key")["day"].max()
    m84 = tx["day"] > day - 84
    out["n_stores_84d"] = tx[m84].groupby("household_key")["store_id"].nunique()
    m28 = tx["day"] > day - 28
    out["active_days_28d"] = tx[m28].groupby("household_key")["day"].nunique()
    out["spend_per_active_day_28d"] = vals[:, 0] / (out["active_days_28d"].values + 1.0)

    wk = ((day + 8) // 7) % 52
    out["week_of_year"] = wk
    out["week_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * wk / 52.0)
    out["week_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * wk / 52.0)
    return out

tbl = agent_api.build_features(feats)
if "household_key" not in tbl.columns:

def season_fn(view, s):
    tx = view.table("transactions")
    hh = view.households
    # year-ago future window (s-364, s-336]
    w = tx[(tx.day > s-364) & (tx.day <= s-336)]
    g = w.groupby("household_key").agg(ya_spend=("sales_value","sum"), ya_trips=("basket_id","nunique"))
    # tenure
    first = tx.groupby("household_key").day.min()
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    f = f.join(g).join(first.rename("first_day"))
    f["ya_spend"] = f["ya_spend"].fillna(0)
    f["ya_trips"] = f["ya_trips"].fillna(0)
    f["tenure"] = s - f["first_day"]
    wk = ((s + 8)//7 - 1) % 52 + 1
    f["week52"] = wk
    f["sin1"] = np.sin(2*np.pi*wk/52); f["cos1"] = np.cos(2*np.pi*wk/52)
    f["sin2"] = np.sin(4*np.pi*wk/52); f["cos2"] = np.cos(4*np.pi*wk/52)
    return f

```python
def fit_eval(Xtr, ytr, Xva, yva):
    # log target
    mu, sd = Xtr.mean(), Xtr.std().replace(0,1)
    Z = ((Xtr-mu)/sd).fillna(0).values
    Zv = ((Xva-mu)/sd).fillna(0).values
    yl = np.log1p(np.clip(ytr,0,None))
    # ridge via normal equations with lambda
    I = np.eye(Z.shape[1])
    for lam in [1.0, 10.0, 100.0]:
        w = np.linalg.solve(Z.T@Z + lam*len(Z)*I, Z.T@yl)
        pv = np.expm1(np.clip(Zv@w, 0, 20))
        print(lam, np.abs(pv-yva).mean())

    Zva = ((Xva-mu)/sd).clip(-5,5).fillna(0).values
    yl = np.log1p(np.clip(ytr,0,None))
    A = Ztr.T@Ztr + lam*np.eye(Ztr.shape[1])
    w = np.linalg.solve(A, Ztr.T@yl)
    pv = np.expm1(np.clip(Zva@w,0,20))
    return np.abs(pv-yva).mean()
```

```python
def fit_eval(Xtr, ytr, Xva, yva):
    # log target
    mu, sd = Xtr.mean(), Xtr.std().replace(0,1)
    Z = ((Xtr-mu)/sd).fillna(0).values
    Zv = ((Xva-mu)/sd).fillna(0).values
    yl = np.log1p(np.clip(ytr,0,None))
    # ridge via normal equations with lambda
    I = np.eye(Z.shape[1])
    for lam in [1.0, 10.0, 100.0]:
        w = np.linalg.solve(Z.T@Z + lam*len(Z)*I, Z.T@yl)
        pv = np.expm1(np.clip(Zv@w, 0, 20))
        print(lam, np.abs(pv-yva).mean())

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

train_days = agent_api.snapshot_days()["train"]
tgt = agent_api.train_targets()

def hh_index(v):
    hh = v.households
    if isinstance(hh, pd.DataFrame):
        return pd.Index(hh["household_key"])
    return pd.Index(hh)

def compute_block(v, d):
    hs = hh_index(v)
    tx = v.table("transactions")
    tx = tx[tx.household_key.isin(set(hs))]
    red = v.table("coupon_redemptions")
    red = red[red.household_key.isin(set(hs))]
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hs)
    # aligned windows
    W = []
    for k in range(1, 14):
        m = (tx.day > d - 28*k) & (tx.day <= d - 28*(k-1))
        w = tx[m].groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum().reindex(hs, fill_value=0.0)
        out[f"w{k}"] = w
        W.append(w)
    Wdf = pd.concat(W, axis=1)
    out["dsl"] = (d - tx.groupby("household_key").day.max()).reindex(hs)
    out["tenure"] = (d - tx.groupby("household_key").day.min()).reindex(hs)
    t28 = tx[tx.day > d-28]; t84 = tx[tx.day > d-84]; t364 = tx[tx.day > d-364]
    out["trips28"] = t28.groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique().reindex(hs, fill_value=0)
    g84 = t84.groupby("household_key")
    sp84 = g84.sales_value.sum().reindex(hs, fill_value=0.0)
    out["sp84"] = sp84
    for c in ["retail_disc","coupon_disc","coupon_match_disc"]:
        out[c+"_84"] = g84[c].sum().abs().reindex(hs, fill_value=0.0)
        out[c+"_364"] = t364.groupby("household_key")[c].sum().abs().reindex(hs, fill_value=0.0)
    sp364 = t364.groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum().reindex(hs, fill_value=0.0)
    out["disc_share84"] = (out["retail_disc_84"]+out["coupon_disc_84"]+out["coupon_match_disc_84"]) / (sp84.abs()+1)
    out["disc_share364"] = (out["retail_disc_364"]+out["coupon_disc_364"]+out["coupon_match_disc_364"]) / (sp364.abs()+1)
    out["units84"] = g84.quantity.sum().reindex(hs, fill_value=0.0)
    out["unit_price84"] = sp84 / (out["units84"].abs()+1)
    out["nstore84"] = g84.store_id.nunique().reindex(hs, fill_value=0)
    ts = t84.groupby(["household_key","store_id"]).sales_value.sum()
    out["topstore_share84"] = ts.groupby(level=0).max() / (ts.groupby(level=0).sum().abs()+1e-9)
    out["nprod84"] = g84.product_id.nunique().reindex(hs, fill_value=0)
    out["prod_per_trip84"] = out["nprod84"] / (t84.groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique().reindex(hs, fill_value=1))
    # timing per basket
    bt = t84.groupby(["household_key","basket_id"]).agg(tt=("trans_time","median"), day=("day","first"))
    btt = bt.reset_index()
    gbt = btt.groupby("household_key")
    out["eve_share84"] = gbt.tt.apply(lambda s: (s>=1700).mean()).reindex(hs)
    out["wknd_share84"] = gbt.day.apply(lambda s: (s % 7 >= 5).mean()).reindex(hs)
    # zero-window stats
    Z = (Wdf == 0)
    out["zero_cnt13"] = Z.sum(axis=1)
    out["mean_nonzero_w"] = Wdf.where(~Z).mean(axis=1).fillna(0.0)
    # longest zero streak
    def streak(row):
        best=cur=0
        for x in row:
            cur = cur+1 if x else 0
            best = max(best,cur)
        return best
    out["zero_streak"] = Z.apply(streak, axis=1)  # may be slow-ish; 2400x13 fine
    # gap stats over 364
    t364s = t364[["household_key","day"]].drop_duplicates().sort_values(["household_key","day"])
    gd = t364s.groupby("household_key").day
    lastd = gd.max(); firstd = gd.min(); ntr = gd.size()
    dif = gd.diff()
    maxgap_in = dif.groupby(t364s.household_key).max()  # careful: diff across household boundary

    va = data[data.snapshot_day.isin(tr_days_ev)]
    Xtr = tr[feats].astype(float); ytr = tr.future_spend_4w.values
    Xva = va[feats].astype(float); yva = va.future_spend_4w.values
    mu = Xtr.mean(); sd = (Xtr.std()+1e-9)
    Ztr = ((Xtr-mu)/sd).clip(-5,5).fillna(0).values
    Zva = ((Xva-mu)/sd).clip(-5,5).fillna(0).values
    yl = np.log1p(np.clip(ytr,0,None))
    A = Ztr.T@Ztr + lam*np.eye(Ztr.shape[1])
    w = np.linalg.solve(A, Ztr.T@yl)
    pv = np.expm1(np.clip(Zva@w,0,20))
    return np.abs(pv-yva).mean()

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    t = view.table("transactions")
    t = t[t.household_key.isin(set(hh))]
    if len(t)==0:
        # empty fallback
        cols = [...]
        return pd.DataFrame(index=hh, columns=cols, dtype=float)
    t["disc_amt"] = t.coupon_disc.abs() + t.coupon_match_disc.abs() + t.retail_disc.abs()
    g = t.groupby("household_key")
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)

    def win(days):
        return t[t.day > snapshot_day - days]

    # discount shares
    for w,name in [(84,"84"),(364,"364")]:
        tw = win(w)
        sp = tw.groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum()
        da = tw.groupby("household_key").disc_amt.sum()
        out[f"b_dealshare_{name}"] = (da/(sp+da)).reindex(hh)  # if sales_value net of discounts, sp+da approximates gross
        out[f"b_couponshare_{name}"] = (tw.groupby("household_key").coupon_disc.abs().sum()/(sp+da)).reindex(hh)
    # units & basket structure
    for w,name in [(28,"28"),(84,"84")]:
        tw = win(w)
        gg = tw.groupby("household_key")
        out[f"b_units_{name}"] = gg.quantity.sum().reindex(hh)
        out[f"b_lines_{name}"] = gg.size().reindex(hh)
        out[f"b_nprod_{name}"] = tw.groupby("household_key").product_id.nunique().reindex(hh)
        trips = tw.groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique()
        out[f"b_lines_per_trip_{name}"] = (gg.size()/trips).reindex(hh)
        out[f"b_units_per_trip_{name}"] = (gg.quantity.sum()/trips).reindex(hh)
        sp = gg.sales_value.sum()
        un = gg.quantity.sum().replace(0,np.nan)
        out[f"b_unit_price_{name}"] = (sp/un).reindex(hh)
    # tenure / lifetime
    first_day = g.day.min()
    out["b_tenure"] = (snapshot_day - first_day).reindex(hh)
    out["b_life_spend"] = g.sales_value.sum().reindex(hh)
    out["b_life_trips"] = g.basket_id.nunique().reindex(hh)
    out["b_life_spend_pw"] = (out["b_life_spend"]/ (out["b_tenure"]/7).clip(lower=1)).reindex(hh)
    # active weeks share last 84d
    tw = win(84)
    wk = ((tw.day + 8)//7)
    act = tw.assign(wk=wk).groupby("household_key").wk.nunique()
    out["b_active_weeks_84"] = (act/12).reindex(hh)
    # longest gap in last 112d
    tw = win(112)
    def max_gap(s):
        s = np.sort(s.unique())
        if len(s)==0: return np.nan
        gaps = np.diff(s)
        edge = max(s[0]-(snapshot_day-112), snapshot_day-s[-1])
        return max(gaps.max() if len(gaps)>0 else 0, edge)
    out["b_maxgap_112"] = tw.groupby("household_key").day.apply(max_gap).reindex(hh)
    # zero 7d periods in last 84d = 12 - active weeks (same as above) -> use active weeks only
    # trips concentration
    tr28 = win(28).groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique()
    tr84 = win(84).groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique()
    out["b_trip_conc"] = (tr28/3 / (tr84/12)).reindex(hh)  # ratio of weekly trip rates
    # timing
    tw = win(84)
    tt = tw.groupby("household_key").trans_time.mean().reindex(hh)
    out["b_trans_time_84"] = tt
    # evening share: trans_time >= 1700
    ev = tw.assign(ev=(tw.trans_time>=1700)).groupby("household_key").ev.mean()
    out["b_evening_share_84"] = ev.reindex(hh)
    # stores
    out["b_nstores_84"] = tw.groupby("household_key").store_id.nunique().reindex(hh)
    top = tw.groupby(["household_key","store_id"]).sales_value.sum().reset_index()
    tot = top.groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum()
    mx = top.groupby("household_key").sales_value.max()
    out["b_topstore_share_84"] = (mx/tot).reindex(hh)
    # volatility of 28d windows w1..w6
    vals = []
    for k in range(6):
        lo = snapshot_day - 28*(k+1)
        m = (t.day > lo) & (t.day <= lo+28)
        vals.append(t[m].groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum())
    W = pd.concat(vals, axis=1)
    W = W.reindex(hh).fillna(0)
    out["b_w_mean6"] = W.mean(axis=1)
    out["b_w_std6"] = W.std(axis=1)
    out["b_w_cv6"] = out["b_w_std6"]/out["b_w_mean6"].replace(0,np.nan)
    out["b_w_min6"] = W.min(axis=1)
    out["b_w_max6"] = W.max(axis=1)
    # slope: mean(w1,w2) - mean(w5,w6)
    out["b_w_slope"] = W.iloc[:,:2].mean(axis=1) - W.iloc[:,4:6].mean(axis=1)
    return out
```

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import agent_api

base = agent_api.load_saved("season_demo_v1.parquet")
print("base", base.shape)

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    t = view.table("transactions")
    t = t[t.household_key.isin(hh)]
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    if len(t):
        t = t.copy()
        t["qty"] = pd.to_numeric(t.quantity, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
        g = t.groupby("household_key")
        out["b_tenure"] = (snapshot_day - g.day.min()).reindex(hh)
        out["b_life_spend"] = g.sales_value.sum().reindex(hh)
        out["b_life_trips"] = g.basket_id.nunique().reindex(hh)
        out["b_life_spend_pw"] = out["b_life_spend"] / (out["b_tenure"]/7.0).clip(lower=1)

        def wstats(days):
            tw = t[t.day > snapshot_day - days]
            gg = tw.groupby("household_key")
            return gg

        # active weeks in last 84d
        w84 = ((snapshot_day + 8)//7) - ((snapshot_day - 83 + 8)//7) + 1
        tw = t[t.day > snapshot_day - 84].copy()
        tw["wk"] = (tw.day + 8)//7
        act = tw.groupby("household_key").wk.nunique()
        out["b_active_weeks_84"] = (act/w84).reindex(hh)

        # active 28d windows among w1..w6
        cnt = np.zeros(len(hh)); idx = {h:i for i,h in enumerate(hh)}
        spend_by_hh = None
        for k in range(6):
            lo = snapshot_day - 28*(k+1)
            m = (t.day > lo) & (t.day <= lo + 28)
            s = t[m].groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum()
            s = s.reindex(hh).fillna(0).values
            if k==0: W = s[:,None]
            else: W = np.hstack([W, s[:,None]])
            cnt += (s>0)
        out["b_active_windows_6"] = pd.Series(cnt, index=hh)
        Wdf = pd.DataFrame(W, index=hh, columns=[f"w{k}" for k in range(1,7)])
        out["b_w_mean6"] = Wdf.mean(axis=1)
        out["b_w_std6"] = Wdf.std(axis=1)
        out["b_w_cv6"] = out["b_w_std6"] / out["b_w_mean6"].replace(0, np.nan)
        out["b_w_min6"] = Wdf.min(axis=1)
        out["b_w_max6"] = Wdf.max(axis=1)
        out["b_w_slope"] = Wdf[["w1","w2"]].mean(axis=1) - Wdf[["w5","w6"]].mean(axis=1)

        # max gap in last 112d
        tw2 = t[t.day > snapshot_day - 112]
        def max_gap(s):
            d = np.sort(s.values)
            lo = snapshot_day - 111
            gaps = np.diff(d)
            mg = gaps.max() if len(gaps) else 0
            mg = max(mg, d[0]-lo, snapshot_day - d[-1])
            return mg
        out["b_maxgap_112"] = tw2.groupby("household_key").day.apply(max_gap).reindex(hh)

        # trip concentration
        w28n = ((snapshot_day + 8)//7) - ((snapshot_day - 27 + 8)//7) + 1
        tr28 = t[t.day > snapshot_day - 28].groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique()
        tr84 = t[t.day > snapshot_day - 84].groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique()
        out["b_trip_conc"] = ((tr28/w28n) / (tr84/w84).replace(0, np.nan)).reindex(hh)

        # basket scale last 84d
        tw = t[t.day > snapshot_day - 84]
        gg = tw.groupby("household_key")
        trips = gg.basket_id.nunique()
        out["b_units_84"] = gg.qty.sum().reindex(hh)
        out["b_units_per_trip_84"] = (gg.qty.sum()/trips).reindex(hh)
        out["b_nprod_84"] = gg.product_id.nunique().reindex(hh)
        out["b_lines_per_trip_84"] = (gg.size()/trips).reindex(hh)
    # ensure float
    out = out.astype(float)
    return out

feat = agent_api.build_features(fn)
print("feat", feat.shape)
m = base.merge(feat.reset_index(), on=["household_key","snapshot_day"], how="left")
print("merged", m.shape)
assert m.shape[0] == base.shape[0]
path = agent_api.save_table(m, "churn_vol_v1")
print(path)
```

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    t = view.table("transactions")
    t = t[t.household_key.isin(set(hh))]
    if len(t)==0:
        # empty fallback
        cols = [...]
        return pd.DataFrame(index=hh, columns=cols, dtype=float)
    t["disc_amt"] = t.coupon_disc.abs() + t.coupon_match_disc.abs() + t.retail_disc.abs()
    g = t.groupby("household_key")
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)

    def win(days):
        return t[t.day > snapshot_day - days]

    # discount shares
    for w,name in [(84,"84"),(364,"364")]:
        tw = win(w)
        sp = tw.groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum()
        da = tw.groupby("household_key").disc_amt.sum()
        out[f"b_dealshare_{name}"] = (da/(sp+da)).reindex(hh)  # if sales_value net of discounts, sp+da approximates gross
        out[f"b_couponshare_{name}"] = (tw.groupby("household_key").coupon_disc.abs().sum()/(sp+da)).reindex(hh)
    # units & basket structure
    for w,name in [(28,"28"),(84,"84")]:
        tw = win(w)
        gg = tw.groupby("household_key")
        out[f"b_units_{name}"] = gg.quantity.sum().reindex(hh)
        out[f"b_lines_{name}"] = gg.size().reindex(hh)
        out[f"b_nprod_{name}"] = tw.groupby("household_key").product_id.nunique().reindex(hh)
        trips = tw.groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique()
        out[f"b_lines_per_trip_{name}"] = (gg.size()/trips).reindex(hh)
        out[f"b_units_per_trip_{name}"] = (gg.quantity.sum()/trips).reindex(hh)
        sp = gg.sales_value.sum()
        un = gg.quantity.sum().replace(0,np.nan)
        out[f"b_unit_price_{name}"] = (sp/un).reindex(hh)
    # tenure / lifetime
    first_day = g.day.min()
    out["b_tenure"] = (snapshot_day - first_day).reindex(hh)
    out["b_life_spend"] = g.sales_value.sum().reindex(hh)
    out["b_life_trips"] = g.basket_id.nunique().reindex(hh)
    out["b_life_spend_pw"] = (out["b_life_spend"]/ (out["b_tenure"]/7).clip(lower=1)).reindex(hh)
    # active weeks share last 84d
    tw = win(84)
    wk = ((tw.day + 8)//7)
    act = tw.assign(wk=wk).groupby("household_key").wk.nunique()
    out["b_active_weeks_84"] = (act/12).reindex(hh)
    # longest gap in last 112d
    tw = win(112)
    def max_gap(s):
        s = np.sort(s.unique())
        if len(s)==0: return np.nan
        gaps = np.diff(s)
        edge = max(s[0]-(snapshot_day-112), snapshot_day-s[-1])
        return max(gaps.max() if len(gaps)>0 else 0, edge)
    out["b_maxgap_112"] = tw.groupby("household_key").day.apply(max_gap).reindex(hh)
    # zero 7d periods in last 84d = 12 - active weeks (same as above) -> use active weeks only
    # trips concentration
    tr28 = win(28).groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique()
    tr84 = win(84).groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique()
    out["b_trip_conc"] = (tr28/3 / (tr84/12)).reindex(hh)  # ratio of weekly trip rates
    # timing
    tw = win(84)
    tt = tw.groupby("household_key").trans_time.mean().reindex(hh)
    out["b_trans_time_84"] = tt
    # evening share: trans_time >= 1700
    ev = tw.assign(ev=(tw.trans_time>=1700)).groupby("household_key").ev.mean()
    out["b_evening_share_84"] = ev.reindex(hh)
    # stores
    out["b_nstores_84"] = tw.groupby("household_key").store_id.nunique().reindex(hh)
    top = tw.groupby(["household_key","store_id"]).sales_value.sum().reset_index()
    tot = top.groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum()
    mx = top.groupby("household_key").sales_value.max()
    out["b_topstore_share_84"] = (mx/tot).reindex(hh)
    # volatility of 28d windows w1..w6
    vals = []
    for k in range(6):
        lo = snapshot_day - 28*(k+1)
        m = (t.day > lo) & (t.day <= lo+28)
        vals.append(t[m].groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum())
    W = pd.concat(vals, axis=1)
    W = W.reindex(hh).fillna(0)
    out["b_w_mean6"] = W.mean(axis=1)
    out["b_w_std6"] = W.std(axis=1)
    out["b_w_cv6"] = out["b_w_std6"]/out["b_w_mean6"].replace(0,np.nan)
    out["b_w_min6"] = W.min(axis=1)
    out["b_w_max6"] = W.max(axis=1)
    # slope: mean(w1,w2) - mean(w5,w6)
    out["b_w_slope"] = W.iloc[:,:2].mean(axis=1) - W.iloc[:,4:6].mean(axis=1)
    return out
```

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import agent_api

base = agent_api.load_saved("season_demo_v1.parquet")
print("base", base.shape)

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    t = view.table("transactions")
    t = t[t.household_key.isin(hh)]
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    if len(t):
        t = t.copy()
        t["qty"] = pd.to_numeric(t.quantity, errors="coerce").fillna(0).clip(lower=0)
        g = t.groupby("household_key")
        out["b_tenure"] = (snapshot_day - g.day.min()).reindex(hh)
        out["b_life_spend"] = g.sales_value.sum().reindex(hh)
        out["b_life_trips"] = g.basket_id.nunique().reindex(hh)
        out["b_life_spend_pw"] = out["b_life_spend"] / (out["b_tenure"]/7.0).clip(lower=1)

        def wstats(days):
            tw = t[t.day > snapshot_day - days]
            gg = tw.groupby("household_key")
            return gg

        # active weeks in last 84d
        w84 = ((snapshot_day + 8)//7) - ((snapshot_day - 83 + 8)//7) + 1
        tw = t[t.day > snapshot_day - 84].copy()
        tw["wk"] = (tw.day + 8)//7
        act = tw.groupby("household_key").wk.nunique()
        out["b_active_weeks_84"] = (act/w84).reindex(hh)

        # active 28d windows among w1..w6
        cnt = np.zeros(len(hh)); idx = {h:i for i,h in enumerate(hh)}
        spend_by_hh = None
        for k in range(6):
            lo = snapshot_day - 28*(k+1)
            m = (t.day > lo) & (t.day <= lo + 28)
            s = t[m].groupby("household_key").sales_value.sum()
            s = s.reindex(hh).fillna(0).values
            if k==0: W = s[:,None]
            else: W = np.hstack([W, s[:,None]])
            cnt += (s>0)
        out["b_active_windows_6"] = pd.Series(cnt, index=hh)
        Wdf = pd.DataFrame(W, index=hh, columns=[f"w{k}" for k in range(1,7)])
        out["b_w_mean6"] = Wdf.mean(axis=1)
        out["b_w_std6"] = Wdf.std(axis=1)
        out["b_w_cv6"] = out["b_w_std6"] / out["b_w_mean6"].replace(0, np.nan)
        out["b_w_min6"] = Wdf.min(axis=1)
        out["b_w_max6"] = Wdf.max(axis=1)
        out["b_w_slope"] = Wdf[["w1","w2"]].mean(axis=1) - Wdf[["w5","w6"]].mean(axis=1)

        # max gap in last 112d
        tw2 = t[t.day > snapshot_day - 112]
        def max_gap(s):
            d = np.sort(s.values)
            lo = snapshot_day - 111
            gaps = np.diff(d)
            mg = gaps.max() if len(gaps) else 0
            mg = max(mg, d[0]-lo, snapshot_day - d[-1])
            return mg
        out["b_maxgap_112"] = tw2.groupby("household_key").day.apply(max_gap).reindex(hh)

        # trip concentration
        w28n = ((snapshot_day + 8)//7) - ((snapshot_day - 27 + 8)//7) + 1
        tr28 = t[t.day > snapshot_day - 28].groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique()
        tr84 = t[t.day > snapshot_day - 84].groupby("household_key").basket_id.nunique()
        out["b_trip_conc"] = ((tr28/w28n) / (tr84/w84).replace(0, np.nan)).reindex(hh)

        # basket scale last 84d
        tw = t[t.day > snapshot_day - 84]
        gg = tw.groupby("household_key")
        trips = gg.basket_id.nunique()
        out["b_units_84"] = gg.qty.sum().reindex(hh)
        out["b_units_per_trip_84"] = (gg.qty.sum()/trips).reindex(hh)
        out["b_nprod_84"] = gg.product_id.nunique().reindex(hh)
        out["b_lines_per_trip_84"] = (gg.size()/trips).reindex(hh)
    # ensure float
    out = out.astype(float)
    return out

feat = agent_api.build_features(fn)
print("feat", feat.shape)
m = base.merge(feat.reset_index(), on=["household_key","snapshot_day"], how="left")
print("merged", m.shape)
assert m.shape[0] == base.shape[0]
path = agent_api.save_table(m, "churn_vol_v1")
print(path)
```

    out["b_tenure"] = (snapshot_day - g["day"].min()).reindex(hh)
    out["b_life_spend"] = g["sales_value"].sum().reindex(hh)
    out["b_life_trips"] = g["basket_id"].nunique().reindex(hh)

    Wdf = pd.DataFrame(np.array(W).T, index=hh, columns=[f"w{k}" for k in range(1, 7)])
    out["b_active_windows_6"] = cnt
    out["b_w_mean6"] = Wdf.mean(axis=1)

    out["b_w_slope"] = Wdf[["w1", "w2"]].mean(axis=1) - Wdf[["w5", "w6"]].mean(axis=1)

    def max_gap(days):

        gaps = np.diff(d)
        mg = gaps.max() if len(gaps) else 0

    out["b_maxgap_112"] = tw2.groupby("household_key")["day"].apply(max_gap).reindex(hh)

    tr84 = t[t["day"] > snapshot_day - 84].groupby("household_key")["basket_id"].nunique()
    out["b_trip_conc"] = ((tr28 / w28n) / (tr84 / w84).replace(0.0, np.nan)).reindex(hh)

def eval_ridge(df, cols, holdouts=(403,431), lam=50.0):
    d = tt.merge(df[['household_key','snapshot_day']+cols], on=['household_key','snapshot_day'], how='left')
    X = d[cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce').values.astype(float)
    y = d['future_spend_4w'].values.astype(float)
    days = d['snapshot_day'].values
    maes = []
    for h in holdouts:
        tr = days != h; te = days == h
        Xtr, ytr = X[tr], y[tr]
        mu = np.nanmean(Xtr, axis=0); sd = np.nanstd(Xtr, axis=0); sd[sd==0]=1
        Xtr_f = np.where(np.isnan(Xtr), 0, (Xtr-mu)/sd)  # after centering, nan->0
        Xte = X[te]; Xte_f = np.where(np.isnan(Xte), 0, (Xte-mu)/sd)
        A = Xtr_f.T@Xtr_f + lam*np.eye(len(cols))
        w = np.linalg.solve(A, Xtr_f.T@ytr)
        pred = Xte_f@w
        maes.append(np.mean(np.abs(pred - y[te])))
    return np.mean(maes), maes
```

def prep(df, cols):
    X = df[cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')

def ridge_eval(cols, holdouts=(403,431), lam=30.0, df=e):
    d = tt.merge(df[['household_key','snapshot_day']+list(cols)], on=['household_key','snapshot_day'], how='inner')
    X = d[list(cols)].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce').values.astype(float)
    y = d['future_spend_4w'].values.astype(float)
    days = d['snapshot_day'].values
    out=[]
    for h in holdouts:
        tr = days!=h; te = days==h
        mu = np.nanmean(X[tr],0); sd = np.nanstd(X[tr],0); sd[~np.isfinite(sd)|(sd==0)]=1
        A = np.where(np.isnan(X[tr]),0.0,(X[tr]-mu)/sd)
        B = np.where(np.isnan(X[te]),0.0,(X[te]-mu)/sd)
        w = np.linalg.solve(A.T@A + lam*np.eye(len(cols)), A.T@y[tr])
        p = B@w
        out.append(np.mean(np.abs(p-y[te])))
    return float(np.mean(out)), [float(v) for v in out]

def eval_ridge(df, cols, holdouts=(403,431), lam=50.0):
    d = tt.merge(df[['household_key','snapshot_day']+cols], on=['household_key','snapshot_day'], how='left')
    X = d[cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce').values.astype(float)
    y = d['future_spend_4w'].values.astype(float)
    days = d['snapshot_day'].values
    maes = []
    for h in holdouts:
        tr = days != h; te = days == h
        Xtr, ytr = X[tr], y[tr]
        mu = np.nanmean(Xtr, axis=0); sd = np.nanstd(Xtr, axis=0); sd[sd==0]=1
        Xtr_f = np.where(np.isnan(Xtr), 0, (Xtr-mu)/sd)  # after centering, nan->0
        Xte = X[te]; Xte_f = np.where(np.isnan(Xte), 0, (Xte-mu)/sd)
        A = Xtr_f.T@Xtr_f + lam*np.eye(len(cols))
        w = np.linalg.solve(A, Xtr_f.T@ytr)
        pred = Xte_f@w
        maes.append(np.mean(np.abs(pred - y[te])))
    return np.mean(maes), maes
```

def prep(df, cols):
    X = df[cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    return X

def ridge_eval(cols, holdouts=(403,431), lam=30.0, df=e):
    d = tt.merge(df[['household_key','snapshot_day']+list(cols)], on=['household_key','snapshot_day'], how='inner')
    X = d[list(cols)].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce').values.astype(float)
    y = d['future_spend_4w'].values.astype(float)
    days = d['snapshot_day'].values
    out=[]
    for h in holdouts:
        tr = days!=h; te = days==h
        mu = np.nanmean(X[tr],0); sd = np.nanstd(X[tr],0); sd[~np.isfinite(sd)|(sd==0)]=1
        A = np.where(np.isnan(X[tr]),0.0,(X[tr]-mu)/sd)
        B = np.where(np.isnan(X[te]),0.0,(X[te]-mu)/sd)
        w = np.linalg.solve(A.T@A + lam*np.eye(len(cols)), A.T@y[tr])
        p = B@w
        out.append(np.mean(np.abs(p-y[te])))
    return float(np.mean(out)), [float(v) for v in out]

            if best[1] < 0:

                continue

            gain_sum[f] += gv
            mask = sub[:,f] <= thr
            L = idx[mask]; R = idx[~mask]
            nodes[nid]['split'] = (f, thr)
            lid = len(nodes); nodes[lid] = {}
            rid = len(nodes); nodes[rid] = {}

            queue.append((L, dep+1, lid)); queue.append((R, dep+1, rid))

        cur = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int32)

        upd = np.array([leafmap[c] for c in cur])

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, time
import agent_api

e = agent_api.load_saved('e011_table.parquet')
tt = agent_api.train_targets()

def prep(df, cols):
    d = tt.merge(df[['household_key','snapshot_day']+cols], on=['household_key','snapshot_day'], how='inner')
    X = d[cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce').values.astype(np.float32)
    y = d['future_spend_4w'].values.astype(np.float32)
    days = d['snapshot_day'].values
    return X, y, days

def bin_matrix(X, nbin=32):
    n,d = X.shape
    B = np.empty((n,d), dtype=np.uint8)
    edges_all = []
    for f in range(d):
        col = X[:,f]
        v = col[np.isfinite(col)]
        if len(v)==0:
            B[:,f]=0; edges_all.append(None); continue
        qs = np.quantile(v, np.linspace(0,1,nbin+2)[1:-1])
        qs = np.unique(qs)
        b = np.searchsorted(qs, col, side='right')  # 0..len(qs)
        b[~np.isfinite(col)] = len(qs)  # NaN bin
        B[:,f] = b.astype(np.uint8)

def gbm(X, y, days, val_day, trees=300, lr=0.08, depth=3, lam=1.0, mc=20, seed=0):
    tr = days < val_day; te = days == val_day
    edges = make_edges(X[tr])
    Btr = apply_bins(X[tr], edges); Bte = apply_bins(X[te], edges)
    n = tr.sum()
    base = y[tr].mean()
    p = np.full(n, base); pt = np.full(te.sum(), base)
    gain_sum = np.zeros(X.shape[1])
    for t in range(trees):
        g = p - y[tr]
        # nodes: list of (idx, depth, nid)
        nodeinfo = []  # (nid, feat, thr, l, r) or leaf value
        assign = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int32)  # train node assignment
        queue = [(np.arange(n), 0, 0)]
        nodes = {0: {'left': None}}
        i = 0
        while i < len(queue):
            idx, dep, nid = queue[i]; i += 1
            m = len(idx)
            if dep >= depth or m < 2*mc:
                v = -g[idx].sum()/(m+lam)
                nodes[nid]['leaf'] = v
                continue
            sub = Btr[idx]
            best = (0, -1, -1)
            G = g[idx]
            for f in range(X.shape[1]):
                bg = np.bincount(sub[:,f], weights=G, minlength=NB)
                bh = np.bincount(sub[:,f], minlength=NB).astype(float)
                cg = np.cumsum(bg); ch = np.cumsum(bh)
                GL = cg[:-1]; HL = ch[:-1]
                GR = cg[-1]-GL; HR = ch[-1]-HL
                gain = GL*GL/(HL+lam) + GR*GR/(HR+lam) - (GL+GR)**2/(HL+HR+lam)
                k = int(np.argmax(gain))
                if gain[k] > best[0] and ch[k]>=mc and (ch[-1]-ch[k])>=mc:
                    best = (float(gain[k]), f, k)
            if best[1] < 0:
                nodes[nid]['leaf'] = -g[idx].sum()/(m+lam)
                continue
            gv, f, thr = best
            gain_sum[f] += gv
            mask = sub[:,f] <= thr
            L = idx[mask]; R = idx[~mask]
            nodes[nid]['split'] = (f, thr)
            lid = len(nodes); nodes[lid] = {}
            rid = len(nodes); nodes[rid] = {}
            nodes[nid]['left'] = lid; nodes[nid]['right'] = rid
            queue.append((L, dep+1, lid)); queue.append((R, dep+1, rid))
        # leaf values for internal nodes' children handled on visit; but leaves created only when visited
        # train update: route rows
        cur = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int32)
        for nid in sorted(nodes.keys()):
            nd = nodes[nid]
            if 'split' in nd:
                f, thr = nd['split']
                sel = cur == nid
                cur[sel & (Btr[:,f] <= thr)] = nd['left']
                cur[sel & (Btr[:,f] > thr)] = nd['right']
        # any node not assigned a leaf? all leaves have 'leaf'
        leafmap = {nid: nd['leaf'] for nid, nd in nodes.items() if 'leaf' in nd}
        upd = np.array([leafmap[c] for c in cur])
        p += lr * upd
        # val routing
        curt = np.zeros(len(pt), dtype=np.int32)
        for nid in sorted(nodes.keys()):
            nd = nodes[nid]
            if 'split' in nd:
                f, thr = nd['split']
                sel = curt == nid
                curt[sel & (Bte[:,f] <= thr)] = nd['left']
                curt[sel & (Bte[:,f] > thr)] = nd['right']
        updt = np.array([leafmap.get(c, 0.0) for c in curt])
        pt += lr * updt
        if (t+1) % 50 == 0 or t == trees-1:
            mae = np.mean(np.abs(pt - y[te]))
            print(f'tree {t+1}: val431 MAE {mae:.3f}')
    return pt, gain_sum

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    day = snapshot_day
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name='household_key')
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    for w in [28,56,84,112,168,364]:
        sub = tx[tx.day > day - w]
        out[f'spend_{w}d'] = sub.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        out[f'trips_{w}d'] = sub.groupby('household_key').size().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['avg_basket_112'] = out['spend_112d'] / out['trips_112d'].replace(0, np.nan)
    daily = tx.groupby(['household_key','day'], as_index=False)['sales_value'].sum()
    for hl, name in [(28,'ew28'), (112,'ew112')]:
        w = 0.5 ** ((day - daily['day']) / hl)
        num = (daily['sales_value'] * w).groupby(daily['household_key']).sum()
        den = w.groupby(daily['household_key']).sum()
        out[name] = (num/den).reindex(hh)
    first = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].min().reindex(hh)
    fk = []
    for k in range(1,13):
        end = day - 28*(k-1); start = day - 28*k + 1
        s = tx[(tx.day>=start)&(tx.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        s[end < first] = np.nan
        fk.append(s)
    fk = pd.concat(fk, axis=1)
    out['sc_f_mean'] = fk.mean(axis=1)
    ya = tx[(tx.day>=day-391)&(tx.day<=day-364)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['ya_spend'] = ya
    out['wk_spend_mean'] = out['spend_364d']/52.0
    # logs
    for c in ['spend_28d','spend_56d','spend_84d','spend_168d','spend_364d','trips_28d','avg_basket_112','ew28','ew112','sc_f_mean','ya_spend','wk_spend_mean']:
        out['lg_'+c] = np.log1p(out[c].clip(lower=0))
    # interactions
    demo = view.table('demographics')
    dcols = ['classification_1','classification_4','homeowner_desc','kid_category_desc']
    demo = demo.set_index('household_key')[dcols]
    s28 = out['spend_28d']
    for c in dcols:
        dums = pd.get_dummies(demo[c], prefix=c).astype(float)
        dums = dums.reindex(hh)
        for col in dums.columns:
            out[f'ix_{col}'] = s28 * dums[col].fillna(0.0).values
    return out

import agent_api, pandas as pd, numpy as np

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    day = snapshot_day
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    hh = pd.Index(view.households, name='household_key')
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=hh)
    for w in [28,56,84,112,168,364]:
        sub = tx[tx.day > day - w]
        out[f'spend_{w}d'] = sub.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        out[f'trips_{w}d'] = sub.groupby('household_key').size().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['avg_basket_112'] = out['spend_112d'] / out['trips_112d'].replace(0, np.nan)
    daily = tx.groupby(['household_key','day'], as_index=False)['sales_value'].sum()
    for hl, name in [(28,'ew28'), (112,'ew112')]:
        w = 0.5 ** ((day - daily['day']) / hl)
        num = (daily['sales_value'] * w).groupby(daily['household_key']).sum()
        den = w.groupby(daily['household_key']).sum()
        out[name] = (num/den).reindex(hh)
    first = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].min().reindex(hh)
    fk = []
    for k in range(1,13):
        end = day - 28*(k-1); start = day - 28*k + 1
        s = tx[(tx.day>=start)&(tx.day<=end)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
        s[end < first] = np.nan
        fk.append(s)
    fk = pd.concat(fk, axis=1)
    out['sc_f_mean'] = fk.mean(axis=1)
    ya = tx[(tx.day>=day-391)&(tx.day<=day-364)].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum().reindex(hh).fillna(0.0)
    out['ya_spend'] = ya
    out['wk_spend_mean'] = out['spend_364d']/52.0
    # logs
    for c in ['spend_28d','spend_56d','spend_84d','spend_168d','spend_364d','trips_28d','avg_basket_112','ew28','ew112','sc_f_mean','ya_spend','wk_spend_mean']:
        out['lg_'+c] = np.log1p(out[c].clip(lower=0))
    # interactions
    demo = view.table('demographics')
    dcols = ['classification_1','classification_4','homeowner_desc','kid_category_desc']
    demo = demo.set_index('household_key')[dcols]
    s28 = out['spend_28d']
    for c in dcols:
        dums = pd.get_dummies(demo[c], prefix=c).astype(float)
        dums = dums.reindex(hh)
        for col in dums.columns:
            out[f'ix_{col}'] = s28 * dums[col].fillna(0.0).values
    return out

        # pseudo pairs over last 364 days

def prep(v):
    tx = v.table('transactions')

def build_candidates(tx, hh, D):
    # returns DataFrame indexed by household_key
    tx = tx.sort_values(['household_key','day'])
    out = {}
    g = tx.groupby('household_key', sort=False)
    # global ratio collect later
    recs = {}
    for h, sub in g:
        d = sub['day'].values; s = sub['sales_value'].values; b = sub['basket_id'].values
        n = len(d)
        first = d[0]
        # trailing 28 at D
        m28 = (d > D-28) & (d <= D)
        t28 = s[m28].sum()
        # basket sums in trailing window
        bb = sub.loc[m28].groupby('basket_id')['sales_value'].sum().values if m28.any() else np.array([])
        maxb = bb.max() if len(bb) else 0.0
        medb = np.median(bb) if len(bb) else 0.0
        # pseudo pairs over last 364 days
        start = max(first+28, D-364)
        d0s = np.arange(start, D-28+1, 7)
        pairs_t = []; pairs_f = []
        for d0 in d0s:
            mt = (d > d0-28) & (d <= d0)
            mf = (d > d0) & (d <= d0+28)
            pairs_t.append(s[mt].sum()); pairs_f.append(s[mf].sum())
        pt = np.array(pairs_t); pf = np.array(pairs_f)
        recs[h] = dict(t28=t28, maxb=maxb, medb=medb, n=len(pt), pt=pt, pf=pf, first=first)
    ...

```python
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
api = agent_api

base = api.load_saved('e011_table.parquet')
print('base shape', base.shape)
print('base cols sample:', list(base.columns)[:8], '...', list(base.columns)[-5:])
print('dup cols?', base.columns.duplicated().sum())

def build_block(view, snapshot_day):
    s = int(snapshot_day)
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    need = pd.Index(view.households)
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=need)

    dv_all = tx['day'].values.astype(np.int64)

    # ---------- day-level spend ----------
    gd = tx.groupby(['household_key','day'], sort=True)['sales_value'].sum().reset_index()
    hhv = gd['household_key'].values
    dv = gd['day'].values.astype(np.int64)
    sv = gd['sales_value'].values.astype(np.float64)
    o = np.lexsort((dv, hhv)); hhv, dv, sv = hhv[o], dv[o], sv[o]
    uniq, starts = np.unique(hhv, return_index=True)
    ends = np.r_[starts[1:], len(hhv)]

    # ---------- basket-level ----------
    gb = tx.groupby(['household_key','basket_id'], sort=True).agg(day=('day','min'), val=('sales_value','sum')).reset_index()
    bhh = gb['household_key'].values; bdv = gb['day'].values.astype(np.int64); bvv = gb['val'].values.astype(np.float64)
    ob = np.lexsort((bdv, bhh)); bhh, bdv, bvv = bhh[ob], bdv[ob], bvv[ob]
    buniq, bstarts = np.unique(bhh, return_index=True)
    bends = np.r_[bstarts[1:], len(bhh)]
    bmap = {h: i for i, h in enumerate(buniq)}

    # pooled gaps for global fallback (not strictly needed)
    res = {}
    for i in range(len(uniq)):
        h = uniq[i]
        D = dv[starts[i]:ends[i]]; V = sv[starts[i]:ends[i]]
        f = {}
        nd = len(D)
        gaps = np.diff(D) if nd > 1 else np.array([])
        g0 = s - D[-1]
        f['hz_gap_n'] = float(len(gaps))
        if len(gaps):
            med = np.median(gaps)
            f['hz_gap_med'] = med
            f['hz_gap_curr_pct'] = np.searchsorted(np.sort(gaps), g0) / len(gaps)
            f['hz_gap_curr_over_med'] = g0 / max(med, 1.0)
            f['hz_gap_curr_minus_med'] = g0 - med
            if len(gaps) >= 6:
                f['hz_gap_trend'] = gaps[-3:].mean() / max(gaps[:-3].mean(), 1.0)
        # t-grid
        t = np.arange(D[0], s+1, dtype=np.int64)
        il = np.searchsorted(D, t, 'right') - 1
        gap_t = t - D[il]
        csum = np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(V)))
        hi28 = np.searchsorted(D, t+28, 'right'); lo = np.searchsorted(D, t, 'right')
        sp28 = csum[hi28] - csum[lo]; tr28 = hi28 - lo
        hi7 = np.searchsorted(D, t+7, 'right')
        tr7 = hi7 - lo
        m_all_s = sp28.mean(); m_all_t = tr28.mean(); p28_all = (tr28 > 0).mean(); p7_all = (tr7 > 0).mean()
        mask = np.abs(gap_t - g0) <= 1
        nloc = int(mask.sum())
        w = nloc / (nloc + 3.0)
        if nloc:
            m_gap_s = sp28[mask].mean(); m_gap_t = tr28[mask].mean()
            p28_loc = (tr28[mask] > 0).mean()
            p7_loc = (tr7[mask] > 0).mean()
        else:
            m_gap_s, m_gap_t, p28_loc, p7_loc = m_all_s, m_all_t, p28_all, p7_all
        f['hz_exp_spend28_all'] = m_all_s
        f['hz_exp_spend28_gap'] = w*m_gap_s + (1-w)*m_all_s
        f['hz_gap_spend_ratio'] = f['hz_exp_spend28_gap'] / max(m_all_s, 1e-6)
        f['hz_exp_trips28_gap'] = w*m_gap_t + (1-w)*m_all_t
        f['hz_trips_ratio'] = f['hz_exp_trips28_gap'] / max(m_all_t, 1e-6)
        f['hz_hazard28'] = w*p28_loc + (1-w)*p28_all
        f['hz_hazard7'] = w*p7_loc + (1-w)*p7_all
        # stock-up from baskets
        if h in bmap:
            j = bmap[h]; B = bdv[bstarts[j]:bends[j]]; BV = bvv[bstarts[j]:bends[j]]
            m84 = B > s-84
            meanb = BV[m84].mean() if m84.any() else BV.mean()
            f['hz_last_basket_ratio'] = BV[-1] / max(meanb, 1e-6)
            thr = 1.5*meanb
            big = B[BV >= thr]
            f['hz_days_since_big'] = float(s - big[-1]) if len(big) else 999.0
        sp7 = V[D > s-7].sum(); sp28h = V[D > s-28].sum()
        f['hz_spend7_28'] = sp7 / max(sp28h, 1e-6)
        res[h] = f

    out = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(res, orient='index').reindex(need)

    # ---------- repeat/new product shares ----------
    m28 = dv_all > s-28
    mprev = (dv_all > s-84) & (dv_all <= s-28)
    l28 = tx.loc[m28, ['household_key','product_id','sales_value']]
    t28sum = l28.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    prev_df = tx.loc[mprev, ['household_key','product_id']].drop_duplicates()
    prev_df['in_prev'] = True
    g28p = l28.groupby(['household_key','product_id'], sort=False)['sales_value'].sum().reset_index()
    g28p = g28p.merge(prev_df, on=['household_key','product_id'], how='left')
    g28p['in_prev'] = g28p['in_prev'].fillna(False)
    rep = g28p.loc[g28p.in_prev].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    newv = g28p.loc[~g28p.in_prev].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    p28n = g28p.groupby('household_key')['product_id'].nunique()
    out['hz_repeat_share28'] = (rep / t28sum).reindex(need)
    out['hz_new_share28'] = (newv / t28sum).reindex(need)
    out['hz_ndistinct28'] = p28n.reindex(need)

    # ---------- coupons ----------
    cr = view.table('coupon_redemptions')
    if cr is not None and len(cr):
        cd = cr['day'].values.astype(np.int64)
        chh = cr['household_key'].values
        r28 = pd.Series(cd > s-28).groupby(chh).sum()
        r84 = pd.Series(cd > s-84).groupby(chh).sum()
        last = pd.Series(cd).groupby(chh).max()
        out['hz_redeem28'] = r28.reindex(need).fillna(0)
        out['hz_redeem84'] = r84.reindex(need).fillna(0)
        out['hz_days_redeem'] = (s - last).reindex(need).fillna(999.0)
    else:
        out['hz_redeem28'] = 0.0; out['hz_redeem84'] = 0

```python
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
api = agent_api

base = api.load_saved('e011_table.parquet')
print('base shape', base.shape)
print('base cols sample:', list(base.columns)[:8], '...', list(base.columns)[-5:])
print('dup cols?', base.columns.duplicated().sum())

def build_block(view, snapshot_day):
    s = int(snapshot_day)
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    need = pd.Index(view.households)
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=need)

    dv_all = tx['day'].values.astype(np.int64)

    # ---------- day-level spend ----------
    gd = tx.groupby(['household_key','day'], sort=True)['sales_value'].sum().reset_index()
    hhv = gd['household_key'].values
    dv = gd['day'].values.astype(np.int64)
    sv = gd['sales_value'].values.astype(np.float64)
    o = np.lexsort((dv, hhv)); hhv, dv, sv = hhv[o], dv[o], sv[o]
    uniq, starts = np.unique(hhv, return_index=True)
    ends = np.r_[starts[1:], len(hhv)]

    # ---------- basket-level ----------
    gb = tx.groupby(['household_key','basket_id'], sort=True).agg(day=('day','min'), val=('sales_value','sum')).reset_index()
    bhh = gb['household_key'].values; bdv = gb['day'].values.astype(np.int64); bvv = gb['val'].values.astype(np.float64)
    ob = np.lexsort((bdv, bhh)); bhh, bdv, bvv = bhh[ob], bdv[ob], bvv[ob]
    buniq, bstarts = np.unique(bhh, return_index=True)
    bends = np.r_[bstarts[1:], len(bhh)]
    bmap = {h: i for i, h in enumerate(buniq)}

    # pooled gaps for global fallback (not strictly needed)
    res = {}
    for i in range(len(uniq)):
        h = uniq[i]
        D = dv[starts[i]:ends[i]]; V = sv[starts[i]:ends[i]]
        f = {}
        nd = len(D)
        gaps = np.diff(D) if nd > 1 else np.array([])
        g0 = s - D[-1]
        f['hz_gap_n'] = float(len(gaps))
        if len(gaps):
            med = np.median(gaps)
            f['hz_gap_med'] = med
            f['hz_gap_curr_pct'] = np.searchsorted(np.sort(gaps), g0) / len(gaps)
            f['hz_gap_curr_over_med'] = g0 / max(med, 1.0)
            f['hz_gap_curr_minus_med'] = g0 - med
            if len(gaps) >= 6:
                f['hz_gap_trend'] = gaps[-3:].mean() / max(gaps[:-3].mean(), 1.0)
        # t-grid
        t = np.arange(D[0], s+1, dtype=np.int64)
        il = np.searchsorted(D, t, 'right') - 1
        gap_t = t - D[il]
        csum = np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(V)))
        hi28 = np.searchsorted(D, t+28, 'right'); lo = np.searchsorted(D, t, 'right')
        sp28 = csum[hi28] - csum[lo]; tr28 = hi28 - lo
        hi7 = np.searchsorted(D, t+7, 'right')
        tr7 = hi7 - lo
        m_all_s = sp28.mean(); m_all_t = tr28.mean(); p28_all = (tr28 > 0).mean(); p7_all = (tr7 > 0).mean()
        mask = np.abs(gap_t - g0) <= 1
        nloc = int(mask.sum())
        w = nloc / (nloc + 3.0)
        if nloc:
            m_gap_s = sp28[mask].mean(); m_gap_t = tr28[mask].mean()
            p28_loc = (tr28[mask] > 0).mean()
            p7_loc = (tr7[mask] > 0).mean()
        else:
            m_gap_s, m_gap_t, p28_loc, p7_loc = m_all_s, m_all_t, p28_all, p7_all
        f['hz_exp_spend28_all'] = m_all_s
        f['hz_exp_spend28_gap'] = w*m_gap_s + (1-w)*m_all_s
        f['hz_gap_spend_ratio'] = f['hz_exp_spend28_gap'] / max(m_all_s, 1e-6)
        f['hz_exp_trips28_gap'] = w*m_gap_t + (1-w)*m_all_t
        f['hz_trips_ratio'] = f['hz_exp_trips28_gap'] / max(m_all_t, 1e-6)
        f['hz_hazard28'] = w*p28_loc + (1-w)*p28_all
        f['hz_hazard7'] = w*p7_loc + (1-w)*p7_all
        # stock-up from baskets
        if h in bmap:
            j = bmap[h]; B = bdv[bstarts[j]:bends[j]]; BV = bvv[bstarts[j]:bends[j]]
            m84 = B > s-84
            meanb = BV[m84].mean() if m84.any() else BV.mean()
            f['hz_last_basket_ratio'] = BV[-1] / max(meanb, 1e-6)
            thr = 1.5*meanb
            big = B[BV >= thr]
            f['hz_days_since_big'] = float(s - big[-1]) if len(big) else 999.0
        sp7 = V[D > s-7].sum(); sp28h = V[D > s-28].sum()
        f['hz_spend7_28'] = sp7 / max(sp28h, 1e-6)
        res[h] = f

    out = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(res, orient='index').reindex(need)

    # ---------- repeat/new product shares ----------
    m28 = dv_all > s-28
    mprev = (dv_all > s-84) & (dv_all <= s-28)
    l28 = tx.loc[m28, ['household_key','product_id','sales_value']]
    t28sum = l28.groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    prev_df = tx.loc[mprev, ['household_key','product_id']].drop_duplicates()
    prev_df['in_prev'] = True
    g28p = l28.groupby(['household_key','product_id'], sort=False)['sales_value'].sum().reset_index()
    g28p = g28p.merge(prev_df, on=['household_key','product_id'], how='left')
    g28p['in_prev'] = g28p['in_prev'].fillna(False)
    rep = g28p.loc[g28p.in_prev].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    newv = g28p.loc[~g28p.in_prev].groupby('household_key')['sales_value'].sum()
    p28n = g28p.groupby('household_key')['product_id'].nunique()
    out['hz_repeat_share28'] = (rep / t28sum).reindex(need)
    out['hz_new_share28'] = (newv / t28sum).reindex(need)
    out['hz_ndistinct28'] = p28n.reindex(need)

    # ---------- coupons ----------
    cr = view.table('coupon_redemptions')
    if cr is not None and len(cr):
        cd = cr['day'].values.astype(np.int64)
        chh = cr['household_key'].values
        r28 = pd.Series(cd > s-28).groupby(chh).sum()
        r84 = pd.Series(cd > s-84).groupby(chh).sum()
        last = pd.Series(cd).groupby(chh).max()
        out['hz_redeem28'] = r28.reindex(need).fillna(0)
        out['hz_redeem84'] = r84.reindex(need).fillna(0)
        out['hz_days_redeem'] = (s - last).reindex(need).fillna(999.0)
    else:
        out['hz_redeem28'] = 0.0; out['hz_redeem84'] = 0

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    s = int(snapshot_day)
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    tx = tx[tx['household_key'].isin(hh)]
    ag = tx.groupby(['household_key','day']).agg(sp=('sales_value','sum'), nb=('basket_id','nunique')).reset_index()
    idx = pd.RangeIndex(1, s+1)  # hmm pivot columns then reindex
    spm = ag.pivot(index='household_key', columns='day', values='sp').reindex(index=hh, columns=range(1,s+1)).fillna(0.0)
    nbm = ag.pivot(index='household_key', columns='day', values='nb').reindex(index=hh, columns=range(1,s+1)).fillna(0.0)
    Sv = spm.values; Nv = nbm.values
    Kmax = (s-28)//28 + 1
    W = np.empty((len(hh), Kmax))
    for k in range(Kmax):

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

NEWCOLS = [...]

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    s = int(snapshot_day)
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)

    tx = tx[tx['household_key'].isin(hh)]
    ag = tx.groupby(['household_key','day']).agg(sp=('sales_value','sum'), nb=('basket_id','nunique')).reset_index()
    full = range(1, s+1)
    spm = ag.pivot(index='household_key', columns='day', values='sp').reindex(index=hh, columns=full).fillna(0.0)
    nbm = ag.pivot(index='household_key', columns='day', values='nb').reindex(index=hh, columns=full).fillna(0.0)
    Sv = spm.values; Nv = nbm.values; n = len(hh)
    Kmax = max(1, (s-28)//28 + 1)
    W = np.empty((n, Kmax))
    for k in range(Kmax):
        lo = max(0, s-28*(k+1)); hi = s-28*k
        W[:,k] = Sv[:, lo:hi].sum(1)
    s7 = Sv[:, max(0,s-7):s].sum(1); s14 = Sv[:, max(0,s-14):s].sum(1)
    t7 = Nv[:, max(0,s-7):s].sum(1); t14 = Nv[:, max(0,s-14):s].sum(1)
    fd = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].min().reindex(hh).values.astype(float)
    Kh = np.clip(np.floor((s - fd - 27)/28).astype(int) + 1, 1, Kmax)
    out = {c: np.full(n, np.nan) for c in NEWCOLS}
    w2 = 0.5**(np.arange(Kmax)/2.0); w6 = 0.5**(np.arange(Kmax)/6.0); w8 = 0.5**(np.arange(Kmax)/8.0)
    for i in range(n):
        K = Kh[i]; seg = W[i,:K]; w0 = seg[0]
        lvl = (seg*w2[:K]).sum()/w2[:K].sum()
        f6 = (seg*w6[:K]).sum()/w6[:K].sum(); f8 = (seg*w8[:K]).sum()/w8[:K].sum()
        f56 = (seg[:-1]+seg[1:]).mean() if K>=2 else np.nan
        f84 = (seg[:-2]+seg[1:-1]+seg[2:]).mean() if K>=3 else np.nan
        m = seg[1:] > 0
        r_mean=r_med=r_std=r_ew=np.nan
        if m.any():
            r = seg[:-1][m]/seg[1:][m]
            r_mean=r.mean(); r_med=np.median(r); r_std=r.std()
            kk = np.arange(1,K)[m]; ww = 0.5**((kk-1)/8.0); r_ew=(r*ww).sum()/ww.sum()
        z=0
        while z<K and seg[z]==0: z+=1
        act = (seg[:min(13,K)]>0).mean()
        usual = np.median(seg[1:min(K,14)]) if K>=2 else np.nan
        ya = seg[13] if K>13 else np.nan
        carry = ((seg[:-1]>0)&(seg[1:]>0)).mean()
        out['x_spend_7d'][i]=s7[i]; out['x_spend_14d'][i]=s14[i]
        out['x_trips_7d'][i]=t7[i]; out['x_trips_14d'][i]=t14[i]
        out['x_lvl_ew2'][i]=lvl; out['x_f_ew_hl6'][i]=f6; out['x_f_ew_hl8'][i]=f8
        out['x_f56_mean'][i]=f56; out['x_f84_mean'][i]=f84
        out['x_r_std'][i]=r_std; out['x_r_ew_hl8'][i]=r_ew
        out['x_zero_streak'][i]=z; out['x_active_frac13'][i]=act
        out['x_p_s28_rmean'][i]=w0*r_mean; out['x_p_s28_rmed'][i]=w0*r_med
        out['x_p_lvl_rmean'][i]=lvl*r_mean; out['x_p_s28_fmean'][i]=w0*seg.mean()
        out['x_p_usual_rmean'][i]=usual*r_mean; out['x_p_s28_carry'][i]=w0*carry
        out['x_p_ya_rmean'][i]=ya*r_mean
    return pd.DataFrame(out, index=hh)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    s = int(snapshot_day)
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    tx = tx[tx['household_key'].isin(hh)]
    ag = tx.groupby(['household_key','day']).agg(sp=('sales_value','sum'), nb=('basket_id','nunique')).reset_index()
    idx = pd.RangeIndex(1, s+1)  # hmm pivot columns then reindex
    spm = ag.pivot(index='household_key', columns='day', values='sp').reindex(index=hh, columns=range(1,s+1)).fillna(0.0)
    nbm = ag.pivot(index='household_key', columns='day', values='nb').reindex(index=hh, columns=range(1,s+1)).fillna(0.0)
    Sv = spm.values; Nv = nbm.values
    Kmax = (s-28)//28 + 1
    W = np.empty((len(hh), Kmax))
    for k in range(Kmax):
        lo = max(0, s-28*(k+1)); hi = s-28*k
        W[:,k] = Sv[:, lo:hi].sum(1)
    # trips 7/14
    t7 = Nv[:, max(0,s-7):s].sum(1); t14 = Nv[:, max(0,s-14):s].sum(1)
    s7 = Sv[:, max(0,s-7):s].sum(1); s14 = Sv[:, max(0,s-14):s].sum(1)
    fd = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].min().reindex(hh).values
    Kh = np.minimum(np.floor((s - fd - 27)/28).astype(int) + 1, Kmax)
    Kh = np.maximum(Kh, 1)
    n = len(hh)
    out = {}
    j = np.arange(Kmax)
    w2 = 0.5**(j/2.0); w6 = 0.5**(j/6.0); w8 = 0.5**(j/8.0)
    cols_f = {name: np.full(n, np.nan) for name in [...]}
    for i in range(n):
        Kh_i = Kh[i]; seg = W[i,:Kh_i]
        f_mean[i]=seg.mean(); f_med=np.median(seg); f_std=seg.std() (ddof0); p25,p75
        f_ew_hl6 = (seg*w6[:Kh_i]).sum()/w6[:Kh_i].sum(); hl8 same
        if Kh_i>=2: f56 = (seg[:-1]+seg[1:]).mean()
        if Kh_i>=3: f84 = (seg[:-2]+seg[1:-1]+seg[2:]).mean()
        m = seg[1:]>0; prev=seg[:-1][m]
        if m.any(): r = prev/seg[1:][m]; r_mean=r.mean(); r_med=np.median(r); r_std=r.std(); kk=np.arange(1,Kh_i)[m]; ww=0.5**((kk-1)/8.0); r_ew=(r*ww).sum()/ww.sum()
        zero_streak: z=0; while z<Kh_i and W[i,z]==0: z+=1
        active13 = (seg[:min(13,Kh_i)]>0).mean()
        carry = ((seg[:-1]>0)&(seg[1:]>0)).mean()
        lvl_ew = (seg*w2[:Kh_i]).sum()/w2[:Kh_i].sum()
        usual = np.median(seg[1:min(Kh_i,14)])
        ya = seg[13] if Kh_i>13 else nan
    products with w0 = W[:,0]:
        p_s28_rmean = W[:,0]*r_mean (nan-safe: products with nan → nan, allowed)
        ...
    return pd.DataFrame(out, index=hh)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

NEWCOLS = [...]

def fn(view, snapshot_day):
    s = int(snapshot_day)
    hh = pd.Index(view.households)
    tx = view.table('transactions')
    tx = tx[tx['household_key'].isin(hh)]
    ag = tx.groupby(['household_key','day']).agg(sp=('sales_value','sum'), nb=('basket_id','nunique')).reset_index()
    full = range(1, s+1)
    spm = ag.pivot(index='household_key', columns='day', values='sp').reindex(index=hh, columns=full).fillna(0.0)
    nbm = ag.pivot(index='household_key', columns='day', values='nb').reindex(index=hh, columns=full).fillna(0.0)
    Sv = spm.values; Nv = nbm.values; n = len(hh)
    Kmax = max(1, (s-28)//28 + 1)
    W = np.empty((n, Kmax))
    for k in range(Kmax):
        lo = max(0, s-28*(k+1)); hi = s-28*k
        W[:,k] = Sv[:, lo:hi].sum(1)
    s7 = Sv[:, max(0,s-7):s].sum(1); s14 = Sv[:, max(0,s-14):s].sum(1)
    t7 = Nv[:, max(0,s-7):s].sum(1); t14 = Nv[:, max(0,s-14):s].sum(1)
    fd = tx.groupby('household_key')['day'].min().reindex(hh).values.astype(float)
    Kh = np.clip(np.floor((s - fd - 27)/28).astype(int) + 1, 1, Kmax)
    out = {c: np.full(n, np.nan) for c in NEWCOLS}
    w2 = 0.5**(np.arange(Kmax)/2.0); w6 = 0.5**(np.arange(Kmax)/6.0); w8 = 0.5**(np.arange(Kmax)/8.0)
    for i in range(n):
        K = Kh[i]; seg = W[i,:K]; w0 = seg[0]
        lvl = (seg*w2[:K]).sum()/w2[:K].sum()
        f6 = (seg*w6[:K]).sum()/w6[:K].sum(); f8 = (seg*w8[:K]).sum()/w8[:K].sum()
        f56 = (seg[:-1]+seg[1:]).mean() if K>=2 else np.nan
        f84 = (seg[:-2]+seg[1:-1]+seg[2:]).mean() if K>=3 else np.nan
        m = seg[1:] > 0
        r_mean=r_med=r_std=r_ew=np.nan
        if m.any():
            r = seg[:-1][m]/seg[1:][m]
            r_mean=r.mean(); r_med=np.median(r); r_std=r.std()
            kk = np.arange(1,K)[m]; ww = 0.5**((kk-1)/8.0); r_ew=(r*ww).sum()/ww.sum()
        z=0
        while z<K and seg[z]==0: z+=1
        act = (seg[:min(13,K)]>0).mean()
        usual = np.median(seg[1:min(K,14)]) if K>=2 else np.nan
        ya = seg[13] if K>13 else np.nan
        carry = ((seg[:-1]>0)&(seg[1:]>0)).mean()
        out['x_spend_7d'][i]=s7[i]; out['x_spend_14d'][i]=s14[i]
        out['x_trips_7d'][i]=t7[i]; out['x_trips_14d'][i]=t14[i]
        out['x_lvl_ew2'][i]=lvl; out['x_f_ew_hl6'][i]=f6; out['x_f_ew_hl8'][i]=f8
        out['x_f56_mean'][i]=f56; out['x_f84_mean'][i]=f84
        out['x_r_std'][i]=r_std; out['x_r_ew_hl8'][i]=r_ew
        out['x_zero_streak'][i]=z; out['x_active_frac13'][i]=act
        out['x_p_s28_rmean'][i]=w0*r_mean; out['x_p_s28_rmed'][i]=w0*r_med
        out['x_p_lvl_rmean'][i]=lvl*r_mean; out['x_p_s28_fmean'][i]=w0*seg.mean()
        out['x_p_usual_rmean'][i]=usual*r_mean; out['x_p_s28_carry'][i]=w0*carry
        out['x_p_ya_rmean'][i]=ya*r_mean
    return pd.DataFrame(out, index=hh)

def build_rows(daily_spend, daily_trips, first_day, days_list, s):
    # daily_spend: DataFrame household_key, day, spend
    # daily_trips: household_key, day, trips
    out = []
    for p in days_list:
        elig = first_day.index[first_day <= p - 84]
        if len(elig)==0: continue
        d = daily_spend[daily_spend.day <= p]
        d = d[d.household_key.isin(elig)]  # or use index mapping
        # window sums
        def ws(w):
            m = d[d.day > p - w]
            return m.groupby('household_key').spend.sum()
        sp28 = ws(28); sp56 = ws(56); sp84 = ws(84); sp168=ws(168); sp364=ws(364)
        ya = d[(d.day > p-364) & (d.day <= p-336)].groupby('household_key').spend.sum()
        dt = daily_trips[daily_trips.day <= p]
        dt = dt[dt.household_key.isin(elig)]
        tr28 = dt[dt.day > p-28].groupby('household_key').trips.sum()
        tr84 = dt[dt.day > p-84].groupby('household_key').trips.sum()
        last = d.groupby('household_key').day.max()
        df = pd.DataFrame({
            'spend28': sp28, 'spend56': sp56, 'spend84': sp84, 'spend168': sp168, 'spend364': sp364,
            'ya28': ya, 'trips28': tr28, 'trips84': tr84,
        }).reindex(elig).fillna(0.0)
        df['dsl'] = p - last.reindex(elig)
        df['tenure'] = p - first_day.reindex(elig)
        df['basket84'] = df.spend84 / df.trips84.clip(lower=1)
        df['r28_84'] = df.spend28 / (df.spend84/3)  # recent vs baseline
        df['r_ya'] = df.spend28 / df.ya28.clip(lower=1) ... hmm careful with zeros
        df['sin'] = sin(2π wk/52), cos
        # target
        fut = daily_spend[(daily_spend.day > p) & (daily_spend.day <= p+28)].groupby('household_key').spend.sum().reindex(elig).fillna(0)
        df['y'] = fut
        df['p'] = p
        out.append(df)
    return pd.concat(out)
```
